author: Fextralife
description:
Diablo 4 Ultimate End Game Guide - What You Should Do in Lord of Hatred
In this Diablo 4 video, I'm going to be talking a little bit about the End Game of Diablo 4, what you should focus on, how long you should focus on it for, what the different activities are, what the advantages of doing them are, how damage works, and what you should be focusing on equipment wise. How to use the Horadric Cube, how to target farm uniques and mythics, and you know which bosses to face and fight.
